استئيلوا (form X)
# اُسْتُئِيلُوا (ustuʔīlū) /us.tu.ʔiː.luː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَآلَ (istaʔāla)
# اِسْتَئِيلُوا (istaʔīlū) /is.ta.ʔiː.luː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَآلَ (istaʔāla)
